final_claim: For uniformly randomized two-coordinate exact Gauss--Seidel with bounded independent i.i.d. delay \(D\), \(S_{k+1}=S_k/2+(r^2/2)\mathbb E[S_{k-D}]\), and the asymptotic factor is the unique \(q\in(1/2,1)\) satisfying \(2q-1=r^2\mathbb E[q^{-D}]\), with the stated ordering, extremal, and asymptotic consequences.
limitations: Two coordinates, uniform coordinate choice, exact overwrites, and bounded iterate-independent i.i.d. delays only.
The recurrence is for a diagonal-scaled mean-square norm.
